history.summary: NOT A HINDU TEMPLE — Sikh gurdwara, keep-or-drop decision needed. Identified as Gurdwara Shri Chaubara Sahib in village Chitanwala (also spelt Chhintanwala/Chintawala; the village also goes by Mansurpur), Nabha tehsil, Patiala district. Per patialaonline.in, Guru Nanak Dev Ji visited Bhai Chanan Mal ji in the village and his stay was arranged in a chaubara (upper room), giving the shrine its name. Justdial lists 'Gurudwara Shri Chaubara Sahib - Chhintanwala Chintawala, Nabha' with a 4.5 rating. FLAG: coordinates are for Chhintanwala village, not the gurdwara building itself - approximate; CSV town 'Patiala' is only the district, actual village is in Nabha tehsil.

name: Gurdwara Shri Chaubara Sahib, Chitanwala
town_description: Chitanwala (Chhintanwala), also called Mansurpur, is a village in Nabha tehsil of Patiala district, Punjab, on the Nabha-Dhuri/Sangrur road belt (PIN 147201). It is a modest agrarian settlement whose name in the region's records is tied to the visit of Guru Nanak Dev Ji. The town of Nabha, with its historic fort and gurdwaras, is the nearest urban centre. FLAG: CSV town 'Patiala' is approximate; actual village is in Nabha tehsil.
